preconditions.description: The length of the string t is between 1 and 10^4.

postconditions.description: The length of the original string s is the same as the length of the given string t.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
postconditions.description: Each character in the original string s is a lowercase Latin letter.

postconditions.expression: all(s[i] == t[i] for i in range(len(t)) if i not in swap_indices)
postconditions.description: For each character in the original string s, it remains unchanged if it was not involved in any swap operation.

postconditions.expression: all(s[i] == t[j] and s[j] == t[i] for i, j in swap_indices)
postconditions.description: For each swap operation, the characters at the swapped positions are correctly swapped in the original string s.
